name: Bor Wildmane

narrative.details:
Now that you have a medallion and can summon an Abyssal Duke, speak with Bor Wildmane.  He will set you on a task against the Abyssal Council.

Good luck, adventurer.  And if you ever need more medallions, return to me.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
narrative.offerRewardText: Good to see you again, Champion! So you had a medallion made? Good -- you'll need that for your next quest...
